CONSENT CALENDAR
Approve Amendment No. 1 to Memorandum of Understanding No. CS-1203, Consulting Services for Workforce Development Programming for the Hetch Hetchy Water and Power Capital Plan
Approve an increase of 120 consecutive calendar days to the contract duration contingency for Contract No. DB-129.1, Bay Corridor Transmission and Distribution Phase 2 North, to Mitchell Engineering
Award Job Order Contract No. JOC-89, General Engineering (A-License) Construction, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, and Alameda Counties
Approve the assignment and assumption of Grant Agreement No. PRO.0151 from San Francisco Parks Alliance to Earth Island Institute, Inc
Approve an increase of $675,000 to the contract cost contingency for Contract No. WW-687, Force Main Rehabilitation at Embarcadero and Jackson, with Anvil Builders, Inc
Accept work performed by Minerva Construction, Inc. for Contract No. WW-691, Sunset Boulevard Greenway - Phase II Irving Street to Ulloa Street
Adopt a Resolution pledging Commission support of LGBTQ+ Pride Month, June 2022, in the City and County of San Francisco
Approve the use of certain form contracts to purchase and sell electricity and related products
Retroactively accept and expend federal funds to provide assistance to eligible residential and commercial customers who accrued wastewater arrears during the COVID-19 pandemic
Accept the 2022 SFPUC Wildfire Mitigation Plan (WMP) and authorize the GM to submit the WMP to the California Office of Energy Infrastructure Safety Wildfire Safety Advisory Board
Approve the proposed Water Enterprise Security Mitigation Plan
An Agreement with the County of Tuolumne, for an amount not-to-exceed $2,497,197 and with a duration of six years, which will provide funding for enhanced essential services
A Collection Agreement with the United States Forest Service, Stanislaus National Forest, for an amount not-to-exceed $2,330,087 and with a duration of five years
Approve the selection to provide As-Needed Specialized and Technical Services, Water Enterprise, to provide short-term, highly specialized work for the Water Enterprise
Adjournment
